prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Pick Your Pet's Preferred Playstyle", "Select an archetype to match your daily desktop workflow before finalizing your pet's path."]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Desktop Companion Safe", "Log into your existing account to prevent creating duplicate empty profiles and losing your pet.", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Email"]
2: ["Choose Base Species & Personality Traits", "Customize Personality"]
3: ["Your Pet is Ready for Desktop Action!", "View Control Shortcuts"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Animations", "Click the preview icons below to test how your pet will react to your cursor while you wait.", "Preview Actions"]
5: ["Choose Your Path & Claim Pioneer Pet Badge", "Early Adopter Gift Unlocked"]
6: ["Use a clear front-facing photo with good lighting to avoid custom render errors.", "Good lighting | Clear face | No accessories blocking view"]
7: ["Play Chime when Ready"]
8: ["If your pet hides behind active windows, press Ctrl+Shift+P or click the system tray icon to pull it back to the front immediately.", "System tray icon is located in the bottom right corner of your taskbar."]
9: ["Signing into the same account keeps your existing pet profile intact."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (photo of face)
